subject: [PATCH v9 10/32] mm/migrate_device: avoid leaking folio references during THP splitting

2026-11-05.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the Linux kernel's migration device code where an extra folio reference is taken during transparent huge page (THP) splitting, leading to a leak when the PMD is split into PTE migration entries. The fix involves removing the extra folio_get() call and using the existing migration PMD lock to prevent concurrent MADV_DONTNEED operations from clearing the PMD.
